notes: The frozen graph. Eighteen events over three cities, written through laiive_shared.neo4j_writer - the same path production uses - so node shapes, uid derivation, name_norm and genre families cannot drift from it. Dates are offsets in days from the seed moment, not fixed timestamps, or the whole fixture would expire: every query filters on upcoming events. Coordinates are real, because the nearby leg measures metres. The set is built around near-misses rather than a tidy corpus: same genre wrong city, right city wrong genre, a venue just outside the radius, a free night, a cancelled event, and two venues whose names share a prefix. Every upcoming event is at least a day out on purpose: an event later *today* stops being upcoming at its own start time, which would make the suite fail for whoever runs it late in the evening.
